doc: A better name for this class would be "fluid", but it's too late for that.

gas.doc: If true, this fluid is treated as a gas (and does not create puddles)

color.doc: Color used in pipes and on the ground.

gasColor.doc: Color of this liquid in gas form.

lightColor.doc: Color used to draw lights. Note that the alpha channel is used to dictate brightness.

flammability.doc: 0-1, 0 is completely not flammable, anything above that may catch fire when exposed to heat, 0.5+ is very flammable.

temperature.doc: temperature: 0.5 is 'room' temperature, 0 is very cold, 1 is molten hot

heatCapacity.doc: how much heat this liquid can store. 0.4=water (decent), anything lower is probably less dense and bad at cooling.

viscosity.doc: how thick this liquid is. 0.5=water (relatively viscous), 1 would be something like tar (very slow).

explosiveness.doc: how prone to exploding this liquid is, when heated. 0 = nothing, 1 = nuke

blockReactive.doc: whether this fluid reacts in blocks at all (e.g. slag with water)

coolant.doc: if false, this liquid cannot be a coolant

moveThroughBlocks.doc: if true, this liquid can move through blocks as a puddle.

incinerable.doc: if true, this liquid can be incinerated in the incinerator block.

particleSpacing.doc: Particle effect rate spacing in ticks.

boilPoint.doc: Temperature at which this liquid vaporizes. This isn't just boiling.

capPuddles.doc: If true, puddle size is capped.

hidden.doc: If true, this liquid is hidden in most UI.

canStayOn.doc: Liquids this puddle can stay on, e.g. oil on water.
